milestones.name: Save or abandon Zote the Mighty
milestones.note: Zote is found in north Greenpath being attacked by the Vengefly King; Knight can save him or let him die

milestones.name: Defeat Vengefly King
milestones.note: Boss encountered in north Greenpath attacking Zote the Mighty

milestones.name: Defeat Hornet
milestones.note: Hornet is fought in an arena in the northwest part of Greenpath

milestones.name: Acquire Great Slash Nail Art
milestones.note: Learned from Sheo at Sheo's Hut in the southwest sector of Greenpath

milestones.name: Encounter Unn
milestones.note: Unn can be encountered at the bottom of the Lake of Unn, further west of Hornet's arena

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Exuberant green cavern with diverse vegetation, mossy valleys, and broad lakes of acid; inhabited by the Mosskin Tribe

zones.name: Acid Lake
zones.note: Lake(s) of acid found throughout Greenpath

zones.name: Lake of Unn
zones.fingerprintHint: Located in the northwest part of Greenpath, west of Hornet's arena; Unn lives at the bottom; shrine and pier on the edge

zones.name: Sheo's Hut
zones.fingerprintHint: Located in the southwest sector of Greenpath at the end of a challenging thorn-filled path; Great Slash Nail Art learned here

zones.name: Stone Sanctuary
zones.fingerprintHint: Located in the southeastern portion of Greenpath, at the end of a dark passage below the Bench room

zones.name: Fog Canyon
zones.note: Connected to the southeastern portion of Greenpath, near the Stone Sanctuary

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Historically connected to Greenpath; the region used to stretch over this area

abilities.name: Great Slash Nail Art
abilities.note: Learned from Sheo, located in the southwest sector of Greenpath past a path full of thorns and Durandas

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Found in the north part of Greenpath, attacking Zote the Mighty

bosses.name: Hornet
bosses.note: Fought in an arena in the northwest part of Greenpath, to the right of the Lake of Unn

objectives.name: Rescue (or abandon) Zote the Mighty
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the north part of Greenpath and deal with the Vengefly King attacking Zote
objectives.leadsToMilestone: Save or abandon Zote the Mighty

objectives.name: Defeat Hornet
objectives.hopDescription: Reach the arena in the northwest of Greenpath and defeat Hornet

objectives.name: Visit Lake of Unn and encounter Unn
objectives.hopDescription: Go to the northwest of Greenpath, west of Hornet's arena, and descend to the bottom of the Lake of Unn

objectives.name: Learn Great Slash Nail Art from Sheo
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate the thorn-filled southwestern path past Durandas to reach Sheo's Hut

objectives.name: Find the Stone Sanctuary
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the southeastern portion of Greenpath and descend the dark passage below the Bench room

connectors.description: Connection in the very southeastern portion of Greenpath, near the Stone Sanctuary
Historical/lore connection; Greenpath once stretched over the Queen's Gardens
